data.research_question: What defensible public organizational location can be attached to Brownes Foods Operations while investigating the queued BHR receiver-authority target, and has any material current development changed the acquisition-authority or location picture?
data.method: Refreshed current main, recent successful hourly merges, open PRs/issues, workflows, operating documentation, executable v0.9.0 schema, topic manifest, and the BHR depth-11 queue through the GitHub connector. Enumerated the current 54-entry dataset/topic universe. Excluded the previous-three successful hourly topics and active direct-conflict hourly PR topics. Seeded dataset-first selection chose topic:hunter-biden. The latest queued BHR depth-11 frontier contained eight targets; six were UK-dominant and excluded because the immediately previous successful run was London/United Kingdom. Seeded selection among the two Australia-dominant targets chose the receiver-authority target. Reviewed current first-party Brownes pages for public organizational-location semantics. Brownes repeatedly publishes 22 Geddes Street, Balcatta, Western Australia as its contact address, and its privacy policy explicitly calls it the registered office; no reviewed source explicitly calls it headquarters. After bounding the location slice, searched current Brownes/McGrathNicol/Indul receiver, acquisition, ownership, and address developments through 2026-08-19 with overlap back to the prior BHR pass. No material current development resolving receiver/board/lender approval, ownership, or a headquarters change was found, so no filler news event was created.
classification_rules: Dataset-stage sampling is across datasets/topics rather than rows, preventing large datasets from dominating by size.
Previous-three successful hourly datasets are hard-excluded when at least four alternatives exist.
Previous-three dominant geographies are excluded at target stage when the selected topic exposes non-conflicting alternatives.
Registered office, contact address, operational site, and explicit headquarters designation remain distinct predicates.
No coordinates are added without a defensible geocoder/source result.
Current news is ingested only when it materially changes the selected investigation; no filler event is created.

findings.selection_algorithm: sort the complete dataset/topic pool lexicographically; remove the previous-three successful hourly datasets and active direct-conflict hourly topics; choose eligible_pool[seed mod len(eligible_pool)]; inside the selected topic, enumerate the latest actionable queued BHR depth-11 frontier, remove targets dominated by previous-three geographies, then choose sorted_target_pool[target_seed mod len(sorted_target_pool)]

findings.result: Brownes Foods Operations' first-party privacy policy explicitly identifies 22 Geddes Street, Balcatta, Perth 6021 WA as its registered office; the current company site independently repeats the address as its public contact address. No explicit headquarters wording was found.

Current searches through 2026-08-19 for Brownes Foods Operations/Brownes Dairy, McGrathNicol, the Indul acquisition, receiver authority, ownership, and address changes found no material new evidence resolving the selected receiver/board/lender-authority question or changing the location classification. No news record was ingested.
